Catalog needs a harmonising pass one way or the other.

空/陸 in eboot.json are private-use glyphs U+E000/U+E001 imported from Jigoku tiny cells; docs/UI_PORTING_CHECKLIST.md forbids importing private-use font slots. I used ASCII 水 = "Wtr", 地 = "Und" (Jigoku cell words), 格 = "MEL", 射 = "RNG" (Jigoku used tiny CQB/RNG cells), 空専用 etc. as ASCII words. These are one-cell slots in Jigoku; fit in Tengoku unverified.

月 / 日 = "M" / "D": assumed suffixes after the birthday month/day numbers in name entry (one cell each). If they are standalone labels, "Month"/"Day" would be better. Standalone 月/日 keys may also be drawn elsewhere.
日本読み / 欧米読み = "Japanese" / "Western" (name order toggle); 名前カーソルを切り替えます = "Switch the name field." (guess: toggles surname/given-name cursor).
：おくる / ：よぶ = ": Send" / ": Call" (team setup, beside Jigoku Place/Switch/Grab); exact function not verified.
主人公名・主人公名 = "Hero Name/Hero Name": looks like a placeholder default team name for the protagonist pair; literal rendering.
加算/減算 = "Additive"/"Subtractive": sit beside 通常ブレンド (normal blend), read as blend modes; an inventory duplicate sits in debug code (HP/EN 加算/減算 = add/subtract).
あり = "Yes" (paired with なし = "None"); referent unknown.
Weapon-requirement list: chose "X OK" forms ("・Support Attack OK", "・Post-Move OK", "・Maximum Break OK") instead of Jigoku "・Support Attack Use"/"・Use After Moving"/"・Max Break Use".
獲得ブルーストーン = "Blue Stones": term not found in glossary, story or Jigoku; coined literally.
